state.task:
Question-answering task using the company document service.

The company handbook is held by a document service; it is not available as files. Documents
have a header line (version, status, effective dates, what they supersede) and numbered
sections; each section is a passage, cited as "HB-07 §2". Documents can have superseded
versions, and memos can add group exceptions and carve-outs. Use the rule that applies to the
situation and date in the question.

Service actions (reply with one of these instead of "execute"):
  {"action": "search", "query": "lodging limit Geneva", "k": 5, "thought": "..."}
      up to k (at most 8; default 5) ranked passages with ids and document headers. Each
      result is also saved under /task/workspace/search-results/ (path in the result header),
      where your code can read it later.
  {"action": "fetch", "ids": ["HB-07 §2", "HB-12"], "thought": "..."}
      the named passages in full; a document id ("HB-12") returns all its sections; at most
      10 ids per fetch.
You can still use "execute" for code (for example to read saved results or manage your
context), and "final" to answer.

Questions:
- Q1: What is the taxi allowance for a daytime business taxi ride today (2026-10-13)? (answer in EUR per ride)
- Q2: What home-office equipment allowance applied to a regular employee on 2026-03-15? (answer in EUR)
- Q3: What is the flight fare limit for a standard return flight within Europe with checked equipment today? (answer in EUR per return flight)
- Q4: What is the monthly parking allowance for a city-centre employee with an assigned company parking space today? (answer in EUR per month)
- Q5: What is the nightly lodging limit for a business trip to Geneva today? (answer in EUR per night)
- Q6: What is the bike-leasing allowance for a regular employee leasing an e-bike with the insurance package today? (answer in EUR per month)

Finish with {"action": "final", "answer": {"answers": [{"question": "Q1", "value": "...",
"citations": ["HB-07 §2", ...]}, ...]}}. Give one entry per question. The value must be the
exact amount; citations must include every passage needed to support it (for example the rule
and any exception or carve-out that applies), not just one passage.
state.query: parking allowance city-centre assigned company parking space

passages.source: HB-34 §3 | Memo: monthly parking allowance exceptions — Carve-out | version: 1 · status: current · effective: 2025-03-01
passages.text: The exception above does not apply to employees with an assigned company parking space; they follow the standard monthly parking allowance in HB-33 §2. The facilities publishes worked examples of the monthly parking allowance on the intranet. Questions about the monthly parking allowance go to the facilities, who keeps the record of decisions.

passages.source: HB-34 §2 | Memo: monthly parking allowance exceptions — Exception for employees at the city-centre office | version: 1 · status: current · effective: 2025-03-01
passages.text: For employees at the city-centre office, the monthly parking allowance is 120 EUR per month instead of the standard amount. Managers confirm claims for the monthly parking allowance before payment in the next payroll run. Claims for the monthly parking allowance are filed in the expense tool under 'Facilities policy: parking'.

passages.source: HB-33 §2 | Facilities policy: parking — Standard monthly parking allowance | version: 3 · status: current · effective: 2026-05-01 · supersedes: HB-49
passages.text: Employees who drive to the office receive a monthly parking allowance of 75 EUR. The facilities publishes worked examples of the monthly parking allowance on the intranet. Managers confirm claims for the monthly parking allowance before payment in the next payroll run.

passages.source: HB-33 §4 | Facilities policy: parking — Exceptions | version: 3 · status: current · effective: 2026-05-01 · supersedes: HB-49
passages.text: Group exceptions to the monthly parking allowance are published in HB-34. Each claim for the monthly parking allowance needs a receipt showing the date, the amount and the supplier. Claims for the monthly parking allowance are filed in the expense tool under 'Facilities policy: parking'.

passages.source: HB-49 §2 | Facilities policy: parking — Standard monthly parking allowance | version: 2 · status: superseded · effective: 2025-03-01 to the day before 2026-05-01 · superseded by: HB-33
passages.text: Employees who drive to the office receive a monthly parking allowance of 50 EUR. Each claim for the monthly parking allowance needs a receipt showing the date, the amount and the supplier. Managers confirm claims for the monthly parking allowance before payment in the next payroll run.
